dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: gender
dimensions.expr: CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Unknown' END

dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN '0-17' WHEN age < 30 THEN '18-29' WHEN age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN age < 60 THEN '45-59' WHEN age >= 60 THEN '60+' ELSE 'Unknown' END

dimensions.name: risk_segment
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN critical_test_count > 0 THEN 'Critical' WHEN abnormal_test_count > 0 THEN 'Abnormal' WHEN total_tests > 0 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'No Tests' END

datasets.name: high_risk_patients
queryLines:
SELECT patient_id, CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS patient_name, age, gender, hospital_name,
  COALESCE(insurance_provider_name, 'Uninsured') AS insurance_provider, total_tests, abnormal_test_count, critical_test_count,
  ROUND(abnormal_test_count / NULLIF(total_tests, 0), 3) AS abnormal_share, last_test_date
FROM adb_rapollocare.gold.patient_360
WHERE critical_test_count > 0
ORDER BY critical_test_count DESC, abnormal_test_count DESC, last_test_date DESC

lines:
### Key Findings (Jan 2025 – Sep 2026, all hospitals)
- **Volume:** 8,248 lab tests across 5,003 patients and 50 hospitals, about 1.6 tests per patient and 1.2 tests per hospital-day.
- **Result quality:** 22.2% of results are abnormal (1,834) and 8.3% are critical (683).
- **Patient risk:** 661 patients (about 13%) have at least one critical result; see the follow-up list on Patient Insights.
- **Patient load is evenly spread:** every hospital serves roughly 100 patients (max 101), so patient count does not separate hospitals.
- **Test volume varies more:** Portland Care Center leads with 186 tests, followed by Indianapolis Memorial (180) and Charlotte Memorial (177), about 15% above typical hospitals (~162–165).
- **Staffing:** about 1.0 test per active doctor-day, which leaves capacity for more tests.

*Figures are for the full period with no filters applied.*
